# Line breaks

A soft line ending
continues the same paragraph with *emphasis*.

A Markdown hard break ends here.  
The following line should stay ragged.

A backslash hard break ends here.\
The following line shares the paragraph.

An HTML break should keep this short line ragged.<br>The next line continues with **strong**, `code` and $x^2$.

中文软换行
接着上一行。中文硬换行。  
接着下一行。中文显式换行。<br>接着下一行。
